children.help_text: Controls the background color of the tabs container. This is independent from the card/panel background and applies to the entire tabs container area.

children.help_text: Configure a custom gradient background for the tabs container. This appears when Background Color is set to 'Gradient'.

children.help_text: Choose a custom color for the tabs container background. This appears when Background Color is set to 'Custom'.

children.name: text_color
children.label: Text Color (Normal)
children.help_text: Controls the text color of tabs in their default/normal state (when not hovered or active). This applies to all tab labels.

children.name: text_color_custom
children.label: Text Color
children.help_text: Choose a custom color for the normal tab text. This appears when Text Color (Normal) is set to 'Custom'.

children.name: text_color_hover
children.label: Text Color (Hover)
children.help_text: Controls the text color when a user hovers over a tab. This provides visual feedback on interactive tabs.

children.help_text: Choose a custom color for the hover state tab text. This appears when Text Color (Hover) is set to 'Custom'.

children.name: text_color_active
